definitions.meaning: Sheppy ( =Sheep-island, cf. Far-oe, Icel. íær a sheep)

quotations.old_english: Hér hǽþne men ǽrest on Sceápíge (-ége, MS. E. ) ofer winter sǽtun

source_text: Sceáp-íg, e ; f. Sheppy ( =Sheep-island, cf. Far-oe, Icel. íær a sheep) :--Hér hǽþne men ǽrest on Sceápíge (-ége, MS. E. ) ofer winter sǽtun, Chr. 855 ; Erl. 68, 23. Hér hǽþne men oferhergeadon Sceápíge, 832 ; Érl. 64, 18.
